visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a beige oversized hoodie, is seen from behind and side profile, sitting at a white desk and writing in a blue folder. The setting is a minimalist, brightly lit room with floor-to-ceiling windows and white curtains. A unique white cardboard Christmas tree with red and gold ornaments stands nearby, and a deer skull with large antlers is mounted on the white pillar. (2) The camera pans to a close-up of the desk surface, revealing a lit scented candle in a grey concrete jar labeled 'ERWACHER', a tablet displaying a male singer, and neat stacks of white cards. The lighting is warm and natural, creating a cozy atmosphere. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of the woman's hands as she uses a black pen to sign her name on the white cards. She turns slightly towards the camera with a bright, joyful smile, showing her eyes crinkling. More signed cards are scattered on the desk, indicating a repetitive task of preparing gifts.
